evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): There is mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament. Both bundles appear intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Medial meniscus: There is a complex tear involving the body and posterior horn, with a radial tear at the junction of the body and posterior horn.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: There is complex tearing at the anterior and posterior root attachments.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: There is moderate to severe cartilage loss diffusely
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: There is mild cartilage thinning and fissuring centrally near the tibial spine.
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is moderate to severe cartilage thinning and fissuring at the patella and trochlea diffusely
evidence.Contusion: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
evidence.Fracture: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
